instruction: I prefer a simpler playlist view in VLC without the tree structure. Could you help me switch the playlist display to list view instead of the default tree view?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires switching playlist to list view in VLC. The evaluator checks the qt-playlist-tree setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 0 (list view). Default is 1 (tree view). Uses custom check_qt_playlist_tree__bf5eef29 metric function.
metadata.verification: Created custom metric function check_qt_playlist_tree__bf5eef29 that reads vlcrc file and verifies qt-playlist-tree=0. Default is 1 (tree view), task requires changing to 0 (list view).
